_doc: SIXTH HELD-OUT real project (Phase 4): Eclipse Paho MQTT Embedded-C (samples/realworld/paho-mqtt, ~7K lines; MQTT packet library + C client with the Linux network port; the C++ client and the vendor-SDK ports (FreeRTOS, CC3200) were removed as a real project would; the platform header is chosen by a build-time macro, MQTTCLIENT_PLATFORM_HEADER, which is not defined: uncompiled). Questions written from facts verified in the source AFTER all Phase 4 re-ranking work and BEFORE Verity was ever run on it. First runs (keyword-only, +embeddings, +local-model re-ranking) kept in bench/results/realworld_heldout6/first-run-*.

cases.q: What happens when the broker does not answer a ping in time?
What happens when an incoming packet is bigger than the read buffer?
What happens when a message arrives on a topic that has no message handler?
What happens when the broker rejects a subscription?
What happens when MQTTPublish is called while the client is not connected?
What happens when the remaining length field of a packet is longer than four bytes?
What happens when the buffer is too small to serialize a publish packet?
How does the packet id wrap around?
Where does the topic name of a received message come from?
